contexts.text: See Naked. AR 213. AR 706. AE 244.
To make themselves belts = to be affected with shame... Being in natural good, they were affected with shame. AC 224.
Shame is (thus) insinuated into him. SE 1696.
Is shame possible without reverence? SE 1051.
On hearing this, he receded with shame.
The shame of injuring society, an internal bond.
That they might be ashamed.
Some, then, are ashamed; some are not ashamed.
They then practise these things without being withheld by shame.
See Fear. SE 3149.
To those suffused with shame, there appears a head nodding, in front.
(Thus) he was devoid of shame. SE 4790.
They shall not be ashamed when they speak with the enemies in the gate () = that there shall be nothing of fear of evils from the Hells. ( = not to be conquered. AE 724:10.)
They shall not be ashamed in the time of evil () = that they shall conquer when tempted by evils.
The truth of faith and good of love are said to blush, and be ashamed, when they are no longer received.
Shame was represented by the hand upon the head. Illustrated.
The strength of Pharaoh shall be for shame () = no faculty of resisting evils from Own intelligence.
To be ashamed () = to yield, being said of those who are overcome.
To be ashamed, and affected with ignominy () = to be destitute of all good and truth; for when such come among the Angels, they are affected with shame and ignominy.
Adulteries are (now) practised without shame...
